Downtown Beaumont.name: Downtown Beaumont
Downtown Beaumont.description: Civic and riverfront core around Crockett Street, Edison Museum, and Downtown arts venues.

West End.name: West End
West End.description: Retail and residential corridor around Dowlen Road and Phelan with steady renovation activity.

South Park.description: Neighborhoods south of US-90 with university-adjacent housing stock and service demand.

North End.description: Historic residential grid north of downtown with rehabilitation pressure and code-enforcement load.

Calder Highlands.description: Calder Avenue corridor and established neighborhoods with infill and alteration permits.
